category.reason: The task requires identifying two numbered routes and tracing them on the map to locate their shared transfer station.

instruction.en: Find the transfer station where metro lines 2 and 19 intersect.
instruction.zh: 找到地铁 2 号线和 19 号线交汇处的换乘站。
